name: splash-check
description: Static semantic analysis for Splash apps (.splash) — the OctoSense framework's own checker, in your editor.

splashCheck.serverPath.description: An absolute path to the splash-lsp binary. Empty: $SPLASH_LSP, then $PATH, then a sibling checkout, then the pinned download.

splashCheck.serverVersion.description: The splash-lsp version to download when no local build is found. Pinned in the manifest so the plugin and the server cannot drift apart; override it to test a local build of the server against a released plugin.

splashCheck.debounceMs.description: How long after the last keystroke a document is checked. Checking a 130 KB app takes ~200 ms, and doing it per keystroke would lag the editor.

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test out-test/test/resolveServer.test.js out-test/test/serverDownload.test.js out-test/test/manifest.test.js
